lines.t: Yes, Lord — that’s faith on feet.
Your will be done — that’s trust when it’s steep.
Amen, Lord — every season, same beat.
He says “I AM WHO I AM” — and the heart finds peace.
[Verse 1]
“Yes” in a prayer, then “yes” when it costs,
Yes when the room says, “Let it get lost.”
Truth on the tongue, then truth in the deed,
That’s how faith gets a set of feet.
Plans on the desk, neatly drawn in ink,
Then the whole thing turns in the time it takes to blink.
“Your will be done” when the road bends twice—
That’s trust with no fine print, no asking price.
Yes, Lord — that’s faith on feet.
Your will be done — that’s trust when it’s steep.
Amen, Lord — every season, same beat.
He says “I AM WHO I AM” — and the heart finds peace.
Amen at the feast, amen through the fast,
Amen when the good news comes in last.
Amen with a voice that can barely get through—
A shaking “amen” can still ring true.
Every season, not just harvest time,
Not just when the numbers climb.
The forecast flips, the headlines spin;
The Name stays the same through all of it.
[Breakdown]
“Yes, Lord” — when it costs.
“Your will be done” — when the plan falls through.
“Amen, Lord”
Amen…
Yes, Lord — that’s faith on feet.
Your will be done — that’s trust when it’s steep.
Amen, Lord — every season, same beat.
He says “I AM WHO I AM” — and the heart finds peace.
Faith on feet.
Same amen.
Every season.
Peace.
